dimensions.assessment: Affects rural-area small businesses and the SEC office responsible for reporting.
The effect is administrative, adding reporting categories rather than creating major economic disruptions.
dimensions.evidence: reports on issues encountered by rural-area small businesses

dimensions.assessment: No federal spending or revenue changes are mentioned in the text.
Amends a single paragraph of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 to update reporting criteria.
dimensions.evidence: Section 4(j) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 (15 U.S.C. 78d(j)) is amended

dimensions.assessment: Permanent statutory change with ongoing reporting reach.

missing_information: Specific cost estimates or budgetary implications
importance_detail.rationale: This bill makes a minor reporting adjustment to include rural-area small businesses alongside women-owned small businesses within existing SEC advocacy reports, resulting in negligible national or economic impact.
